name: Zul'Mamwe Trophy
summary: The Zul'Mamwe Trophy is a skull taken from a Skullsplitter trophy pile in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe. Nezzliok demands it as part of an appeasement tied to the search for Yenniku.

sections.title: A Skullsplitter Trophy
sections.body: Among the Skullsplitter trophies in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe, one skull is meant for the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. Nezzliok, a dead witch doctor, demands it along with skulls from Balia'mah and Ziata'jai. He promises knowledge of Yenniku's whereabouts in return for appeasement.

faq.answer: The Zul'Mamwe Trophy is a skull taken from the Skullsplitter trophy pile in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe.
Nezzliok, a dead witch doctor, demands the Zul'Mamwe Trophy as part of an appeasement.

faq.q: Where does the trophy come from?
faq.answer: The trophy comes from a pile of Skullsplitter trophy skulls in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe in northern Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Where must the skulls be brought?
faq.answer: The Balia'mah, Ziata'jai and Zul'Mamwe trophies are to be placed at the Bubbling Cauldron in Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: Why does Nezzliok ask for it?
faq.answer: Nezzliok says the Skullsplitter skulls will appease his spirit, and promises to reveal where Yenniku was taken.
